name: Guardians of the Altar
label: Quest
description: Guardians of the Altar: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: At the very top of the ridge lies what I believe to be an altar of the goddess Elune. From what I can tell, we need to light the five torches in each cave, and then we will be able to access the altar directly.

I transcribed some incantations carved into the stone in the ancient ruins of Kel'Theril, which I believe are the secret to unlocking the altar. I'll need your help to light each torch, while I recite the spell.
If we are successful, you'll be able to report our findings to Erelas!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Did you meet up with Ranshalla?
